 Play video Bayern Munich 1-1 Cologne Injuries mar Bayern Munich's comeback draw with Cologne
 21.11.2026 3 min read Add Bundesliga as preferred source Bayern Munich dropped points for the fourth time this season after being held to Cologne in a game where Harry Kane and Michael Olise went off with apparent injuries.
 Bayern Munich 1-1 Cologne 
Goals: 0-1 Moore 12’, 1-1 Brown 37’
 Vincent Kompany returned to the Bayern dugout after a month away through illness, naming an unchanged starting XI from the win in Mainz , with 19-year-old Noah Codjo-Evora handed a place on the bench. 
Cologne's René Wagner made one change, bringing Luka Lochoshvili into defence for his first start in four weeks, replacing Marius Bülter .
 Vincent Kompany arrives with his arm in a sling for his first match back on the touchline since returning from illness. - KARL-JOSEF HILDENBRAND Moore stuns the hosts before Brown levels
 Bayern started on top and nearly broke through when Kane's flicked header from a Joshua Kimmich delivery struck the post, though he was later flagged offside. Cologne then struck against the run of play in the 12th minute: Mikey Moore won the ball, fed  Linton Maina , who found Saïd El Mala , and his backheel teed up Moore to round Jonas Urbig and slot home. 
 Kane was forced off with an apparent ankle injury in the 20th minute, replaced by Tom Bischof . Bayern kept probing with long-range efforts before Bischof picked out Nathaniel Brown , who turned away from Jahmai Simpson-Pusey and fired a low drive past Marvin Schwäbe to make it 1-1 in the 37th minute.
 The two sides went into the half-time break level after Nathaniel Brown's equaliser. - Alexander Hassenstein About the players 47 Mikey Moore Striker 1. FC Köln 40 Jonas Urbig Goalkeeper FC Bayern München 21 Nathaniel Brown Defender Eintracht Frankfurt Advertisement Second half: chances traded but no winner
 Olise was withdrawn at the break for debutant Tim Binder . Cologne almost doubled their lead early on when Moore's shot, set up by El Mala, was saved by Urbig. Dayot Upamecano and El Mala were both booked for separate second-half fouls, and Urbig produced a fine double save to deny El Mala and Maina. 
 Konrad Laimer and Jamal Musiala both tested Schwäbe from distance without success, while El Mala dragged a close-range chance wide late on.
 Jamal Musiala returned to action for Bayern to make his first league appearance since September. - Alexander Hassenstein Man of the Match: Mikey Moore
 Moore scored Cologne's opener with a composed solo finish after rounding Urbig and was involved again when his low cross set up a chance for El Mala in the second half.
 He led all players for shots on his side with two, covered 12.5 kilometres, and was voted Man of the Match with 38 per cent of the vote.
 Mikey Moore was named Man of the Match after scoring his first goal for Cologne. - Adam Pretty Bundesliga Match Facts
